No account, no ads, no trackers. chut works offline; your lists and history never leave this phone.

Android asks chut about every incoming call, before it rings. chut answers on the phone, in a fraction of a millisecond, without the internet.

1. Hard rules first. Numbers on your allow list and your contacts always ring. Numbers on your block list never do.

2. Then signals, each with a weight: ARCEP telemarketing range (70), community report (75, or 85 for a scam), failed caller-ID check (60), numbers next to ones you blocked (20 to 60), premium rate (50), high-risk country code (45), malformed number (40), quiet hours (30).

3. The weights combine into a spam score from 0 to 100: two weak signals make a stronger one, but the score never passes 100.

4. Your sensitivity turns the score into a decision: ring, ring silently with a notification, or block.

Every decision keeps its reasons: tap a call to see why. Tap Block or Not spam and chut learns from you.
